clips.title: The story
paras: Brother Kristoff is waiting in Stormwind for a borrowed book to return. After a long search and a delay in Northshire, you bring The Stresses of Iron back to the Cathedral of Light.

Brother Kristoff is waiting in Cathedral Square for The Stresses of Iron, a book on metallurgy. Its trail led from Stormwind Keep's Royal Library to Northshire Abbey, where Brother Paxton was copying the text by hand. Paxton ran short of Rethban ore for the scribe's ink, so the work stalled. With the ore retrieved and the copy complete, you bring the original book back to Stormwind.

Northshire's copyists preserve civic and spiritual lore through patient work. Brother Paxton asks you to apologize to Librarian Milton Sheaf, a sign of how thin the abbey's resources have worn. Scribes must copy valuable books stroke by stroke with mineral-rich ink before returning them to Stormwind's care, making a book request a long undertaking.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron. Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find the book?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's the one! Thank you, friend. May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
